snippet.title: Exoshock: Founder's Edition - Official Early Access Launch Trailer | VR Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Exoshock is a 1-4 cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter built VR-first from the ground up, featuring intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields. Get a closer look at what you can expect from the Founder's Edition of Exoshock in this new video. Exoshock: Founder's Edition is out now in Steam VR and Meta Quest 3. Exoshock will be coming to Valve's Steam Frame, Steam Deck, PS5, and PS VR2.
